info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Logistics Shipments Etas-v3-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments ETA API provides real-time estimated arrival times for logistics shipments. This endpoint allows users to retrieve crucial shipment data, enabling effective tracking and management of logistics operations. Typical consumers of this API include logistics managers and supply chain professionals who need to monitor shipment timelines to optimize operations and improve customer satisfaction. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency and provide accurate delivery updates to clients.

get.summary: Retrieve Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) for shipments.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain the estimated time of arrival for your shipments based on current data and tracking information. You can use this information to plan for deliveries and manage logistics effectively.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for shipments. This JSON object allows the user to specify the necessary parameters to obtain the ETA for the desired shipment.

200.description: Successfully retrieved estimated arrival time for shipments.

ListLogisticsShipmentsEtasRequest.description: The request body for the Get ETA operations related to shipments.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: Unique identifier for the shipment reference.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the request.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message regarding the status or result.

ListLogisticsShipmentsEtasResponse_200.description: Response schema for the shipment ETA operation.

createdBy.description: User who created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the action was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the shipment.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This can help clients understand the response time for performance monitoring.
